"You had so much potential, all of it, wasted! And look what became of you! You're a joke, a clod. I thought you could become as great as myself. But I can see now, that I was wrong."
—Staridot to Peridot, Homecoming Signal

Peridot (specifically Peridot Facet-1 Sector 4 Cut-8AL), also known as Boss by her Peridot underlings, and Staridot by the Crystal Gems because of her hair, is a perfect Era 1 Peridot and a Homeworld Gem that served as Peridot’s manager before she defected. She was mentioned in "Message Received" and made her physical debut in "Homecoming Signal". She is a certified kindergartener, scientist, and technician, who won the title of manager when she successfully helped build the METALA core on the planet Ahl. As of Era 3, she has allied herself with several other gems who wish to restore the Gempire to the way it was before.
Appearance
Staridot has lime-green skin and pale yellow-green hair styled into a star. Her eyes are emerald green in color but appear to be darker due to being tinted by the pale green color of her visor. Her mouth and tongue are bluish-grey, and she has a pointed upper lip. Her gemstone is located on her chest and is shaped like an inverted triangle with flattened corners.
Her outfit is a custom-made uniform. She still has the Yellow Diamond symbols on her legs. She has a slightly curvy figure, with wide hips, a small waist, and a large chest. She is quite big, even for a Peridot, being nearly six feet tall, and stands even taller than that thanks to her dark green high boots. Her uniform is forest green in color with a v neck showing her gem and a dark green stripe underneath it. She has pointed forest green shoulder pads and wears dark green sleeves underneath them. On her back is a dark teal cape that seems to defy the laws of physics as it sways when there is no wind, and doesn't fall over when she is upside down.
Personality
Staridot has a cold, calculated behavior, sadistic, without any remorse, with a strong desire to terminate any being that stands in her way. She is skilled with advanced Gem technology and works for Homeworld as a skilled technician and takes her work seriously, crushing one of her Robonoids underfoot when it was damaged and useless to her. She hates defects and loves torturing defective gems, by sending them into the Shard Games, or cracking them very slowly.
She apparently knows about water, as she went to the planet Ahl, one of the only Homeworld colonies that had water. She knows about the Earth's organic life, and even initially asks Yellow Diamond for the uses of its resources, in a flashback from "Homecoming Signal".
As of Era 3, she has lost her status and now feels that all her hard work and sacrifices were in vain. And desires vengeance against the Crystal Gems.
While many Homeworld gems are uncomfortable with fusion, she is completely disgusted by it. Seeing it as being pointless in trying to merge together to accomplish a simple task. She often enforces this belief onto her subordinates and will severely punish anyone who is willing to embrace fusion.
Abilities
Skills
Piloting: Along with Peridot, Staridot is able to fly various Homeworld ships.
Engineering: She is able to create anything, and use various parts, and mathematical calculations to simply build anything. It is said on Homeworld that she can turn "Black into White" and can mold things out of her hand.
Artificial Gem Creation: She could also create artificial gems, namely "Alkalis" that are used for weapons.
Gem Harvesting: She could also harvest gems.
Arm Cannon Proficiency: She has proficiency in summoning her weapon: An arm cannon. She is able to fire it properly and create energy bullets with it. She can fire multiple smaller projectiles rapidly, or charge it up and fire a large but powerful energy blast. Additionally, the gauntlets seem to enhance her dexterity skills greatly.
Shapeshifting: While all Gems are capable of shapeshifting, Staridot is particularly skilled at it, specializing in transformations. But her favorite method is e long aged her fingers into long tendrils that can act as cables that allow her to hack into any device.
Natural Abilities
Photokinesis: Staridot is shown using her gemstone to project a green light, like a flashlight. It is the first natural Gem ability she has been shown to use. She shares this ability with Garnet, Pearl, Peridot, Ruby (Eyeball), and Ruby (Doc).
Bubbling: Staridot can easily bubble gems without any effort. Her bubbles are a dark shade of green.
Immense Durability: Peridots are rather hard to damage and can evidently take severe amounts of punishment and remain unscathed.
Gem-tech interfering: Peridots are made to do gem technological tasks, and this ability is evident with all Peridots.
Unique Abilities
Holographic Projection: Staridot can project holographic images from her gemstone, which is used for mainly lecturing gems, and to show others their tasks, in Gem Universities, and more.
Ferrokinesis: Staridot is able to levitate and control metallic objects. The extent of her powers, whether she manipulates magnetism or just the metal, is still unknown, though when she gets angry, her powers increase, and become more erratic and violent.
EMP Creation: She is able to generate a ball of static electricity from her fingertips, and when launched disables all nearby electronics for a short period of time. The longer she charges it, the longer it will last.
Telekinesis: She is able to manipulate objects in the form of a green tractor beam emitted from the tips of her fingers.
Wall-Scaling: Staridot can freely run up vertical walls without falling.
Additional Tools
Gem Destabilizer: Staridot wields a Gem Destabilizer, an extremely potent but non-lethal tool used to subdue enemy Gems. As seen used on Garnet, the gem will start to crack apart at the seams and poof into their gemstones.
Robonoids: With all peridots, can control different types of spherical robots known as Robonoids. There are three types of known Robonoids: Flask, Plug and Hand. They can perform multiple functions, such as fixing a Warp Pad and activating Kindergartens.
EMP device: Staridot is able to make a EMP device. About three seconds after being placed, the device explodes, disabling all of her Robonoids. The device seems to be highly advanced, as Pearl's pulse bomb in "Political Power" (which appears to be made from human technology) was unable to disable even a single Robonoid, though it did succeed in knocking out the power in Beach City.
Attack Pod: Like Squaridot, Staridot can summon this manned combat vehicle at will. Although, her’s is much larger and has more artillery when compared to a standard Attack Pod.
Peridot (Staridot)/History
Peridot Facet-1 Sector 4 Cut-8AL is an Era 1 Peridot created on the Gem Homeworld sometime before the Rebellion on Earth with the natural abilities to be a technician and certified Kindergartner.
Before the rebellion
Peridot was made in the Alpha Kindergarten on Homeworld, in Sector 4. She was assigned to create gems and design gem structures. She was known especially for going to Ahl and help build the METALA core, earning the title of "Manager". Her past, in the kindergarten, wasn't pleasant, making her cruel and sadistic.
Rebellion
During the rebellion, Peridot was equipped with weapons to destroy Crystal Gems. She was mainly on Homeworld, building weapons for their soldiers. When she was on the battlefield, she was once poofed, yet, the Homeworld Gems brought her back to Homeworld.
Battle of the METALA core
She partook in the battle of the METALA core, and was shown to have thrown several Crystal Gems into the lava below. In the end, she managed to make several Crystal Gems, including Rose Quartz retreat.
Final days of the Rebellion
On the final days of the rebellion, she left early, as she knew about the diamond's final attack early on. She witnessed the corruption herself, and saw the screams of several gems. She was both amazed and horrified at the same time.
Era 2
Sometime after the Rebellion, Peridot was able to earn subordinates of her command, one of them including Peridot. She was tasked to lead Earth detection, and assigned Peridot to monitor the Cluster as a “promotion” and “getting one last look at what could have been a great colony”.
When she discovered that her Communication Hub has been reactivated by Peridot, she decided to go contact Yellow Diamond about the distress call. However, she wasn't successful in pinpointing the exact location, as Sardonyx destroyed the tower. As such, she decided to inform Yellow Diamond of the list of human subspecies given to her by Peridot and notified her that one of her perfect warriors was still on the planet. As such, Yellow Diamond would eventually send five Rubies to the planet to retrieve her, and would later send an Aquamarine backed up by a Topaz fusion to locate the human subspecies.
Era 3
"Homecoming Signal"
Relationships
Yellow Diamond
Yellow Diamond is her superior and leader. Staridot has a steady relationship with Yellow Diamond. She can calmly talk to Yellow Diamond without showing any sign of fear and is extremely loyal to her if it even means giving up on getting resources from Earth. But after her star student betrayed the Diamond, Yellow became furious at Staridot stating that her star student was a deluded idiot, and was extremely disappointed in what she had allowed Peridot to become. While she could have shattered her then and there as punishment, Yellow thinks that the fact that what she considered her "Star Student" was defective was the most ironic humiliation imaginable. While she does go back on better terms with Yellow Diamond, it meant nothing once she gives up her power and authority over her. Staridot then felt like she was betrayed and disowned by the very being she idolized and now vows to make her restore the old ways of gem kind no matter the price.
Peridot
Peridot's Manager initially treated Peridot as a regular worker, without any feelings for her. However, once she showed great passion for her education and duties, she had taken a liking to her, and had since dubbed her as her “star student”. She was even the one who assigned her with the task of monitoring the Cluster on Earth. But when Peridot betrayed Yellow Diamond, she was enraged by her treachery, and now she wants to punish her for siding with “heretics”.
Crystal Gems
Peridot's Manager treated the Crystal Gems as the first on her torture list. She despises them, and was even more infuriated when Peridot joined them. And her hatred for them grew tenfold once she realized they were the ones responsible for ruining what she believed to be was a “perfect society”.
Sardonyx
She apparently doesn't know who Sardonyx is, but she described the person who destroyed the communication hub as “a musical fusion with a hammer".
Trivia
Her arm cannon gauntlets are very similar to that of modern limb enhancers. However, instead of the fingers being floating rods, they are instead long cables that can change length at will.
She owns a Pearl, which usually Peridots aren't supposed to own.
However, once Era 3 had begun. This was no longer the case as she has since abandoned her master.
Her voice is said to be like Peridot’s but is less nasally, and more motherly while being also deeper in pitch signifying her more mature mannerisms.
Her Cut 8AL is a reference to how Peridots are known as the birthstones of August and the zodiacal birthstone of Libra.
She was created and designed by Sketchabee.
Humorously, Lapis Lazuli and Amethyst find her quite attractive.
